title: The Jews' victory over their enemies in Susa and the provinces
description: On the thirteenth day of the month of Adar, the Jews gather in all King Ahasuerus' provinces and defend themselves against their enemies. Fear of Mordecai, who has become powerful in the king's house, falls upon princes and officials who support the Jews. They kill five hundred men in the fortress Susa and Haman's ten sons. After Esther's plea to the king, Haman's sons are hanged, and on the following day the Jews in Susa kill another three hundred, while the other Jews in the provinces kill seventy-five thousand of those who hated them. They do not lay hands on the plunder. Then they rest and make the day a day of celebration and joy.
